architecture.home_canonical: The server resolves HOME dynamically from Context.getFilesDir()/server-home; ~/OpenCode symlinks to the shared workspace. Wrappers self-resolve HOME from their binary path.
architecture.factory_seed: Version-tracked non-blocking tar extraction + idempotent per-file config updates without overwriting user memory or workspace data.
architecture.bridge_security: Localhost HTTP bridge on 127.0.0.1:4399 enforces per-session X-Bridge-Token authentication; pc CLI uses embedded Bun fetch runtime (zero curl dependency).
architecture.screen_capture: pc shot captures the device display via persistent official Android MediaProjection (MediaProjectionConfig default display + OnImageAvailableListener).
architecture.denies: opencode.jsonc enforces 10 bash denies protecting / and dangerous system commands.
architecture.maintenance: sh ~/bin/opencode-maintenance [days] [vacuum]: WAL checkpoint safe with app open; rotation and VACUUM only with app closed.
architecture.memory_safety: memory.json is validated and system-seed keys synced on upgrade; user projects/memories are preserved and backed up to memory.json.bak.
architecture.cognition: plugins/memory.js guards memory.json (.bak, snapshots, journal) and exposes the memory tool (get/set/del/list/validate/snapshot/journal/dream); nightly NREM dream consolidates duplicates.
